answer: The orchard of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the garden of a task receipt, and the yarrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
